units.source_text: 后来，在伊东续弈时，黑69这意外的一手，名人疑是为封盘而下的，

en.t: Later, when play resumed at Ito, the Master suspected that Black's unexpected move at 69 had been played simply to seal the move,

units.source_text: 顿时心头火起，他想到把围棋玷污到如此地步，

en.t: and anger flared up in him at once, as he thought that go had been defiled to such an extent,

units.source_text: 真恨不得当场把它扔光。

en.t: that he truly felt like throwing all the stones away on the spot.

units.source_text: 好不容易等到小憩，他就向我们倾吐了满腹的气愤。

en.t: When a short rest finally came, he poured out to us all the indignation that filled him.

units.source_text: 面对棋盘的名人，就是在这种时候脸上也不露声色，

en.t: The Master at the board, even at such a moment, showed no emotion on his face,

units.source_text: 甚至没有人觉察到名人内心的不安。

en.t: and no one even noticed the unease inside him.
